content.title: Online CSS Sprite Generator
content.p1: Optimize your website's performance by combining multiple small images into a single file, known as a sprite sheet. This reduces the number of HTTP requests your browser needs to make, speeding up page load times.
content.p2: Our tool automatically packs your images into a grid or strip and generates the necessary CSS code to use them on your website.

pack.desc: Automatically arranges images in a grid to minimize empty space.

flexible.desc: Choose between horizontal, vertical, or grid layouts with customizable padding.

how_to.title: How to Create a Sprite Sheet
list: Select and upload multiple image files (PNG, JPG, GIF).
Adjust settings like 'Padding' or 'Columns' if needed.
Download the sprite image and copy the CSS code.
